{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the original full population response rates
original_control_rate = df[df['arm'] == 'control']['responded'].mean()
original_treatment_rate = df[df['arm'] == 'treatment']['responded'].mean()
original_treatment_effect = original_treatment_rate - original_control_rate

# Check the number of patients with sentinel values
sentinel_mask = df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0
n_sentinel = sentinel_mask.sum()

# Report the original full population treatment effect
original_control_rate, original_treatment_rate, original_treatment_effect, n_sentinel"}
